name: Will Reed
source:
Works for a pharmaceutical company in Britain. He has a stubborn personality, and doesn't bother with flattery. 

Due to his pretty face and nice body, he's very attractive to the men and women around him, but he has no awareness of this. In fact, he has an immense dislike of being noticed by others, to the point where it's become something of a complex for him.

[translated from official site]
